name: Pinzgauer Spaziergang
why: A gentle high walk of grassy ridges from the Schmittenhöhe to Saalbach, with the whole line of the Hohe Tauern glaciers across the valley.
book: Schmittenhöhe cable car from Zell am See; bus back from Saalbach.
water: Huts at the start and the end.
dangers: Afternoon thunderstorms in summer: start early and be off ridges by 14:00.

points.name: Schmittenhöhe
points.note: The summit above Zell am See and its lake.

points.name: Saalbach
points.note: A ski village in the Glemmtal.
